create_optimizer_theta_method: create an OptimizerThetaMethod solver that minimizes the squared norm of the residual of the theta method equation
create_newton_raphson_theta_method: create a NewtonRaphsonThetaMethod solver for nonlinear theta method time step updates using Newton-Raphson iteration
configure_optimizer_runtime_params: configure OptimizerRuntimeParams with max iterations, loss tolerance, and initial guess mode for optimizer-based solving
configure_newton_raphson_runtime_params: configure NewtonRaphsonRuntimeParams with max iterations, residual tolerances, delta reduction factor, and tau min for Newton-Raphson solving
compute_x_new_with_nonlinear_solver: compute new core profile values at time t+dt using NonlinearThetaMethod._x_new with geometry, profiles, and source data
